senses.gloss:
√kḷp 'be adapted'
present: [1.] kálpate etc. V.+ kálpant? 
perfect: cākḷpé etc. cākḷpus cākḷpat cakḷpe 
aorist: [2.] akḷpat -- [3.] acīkḷpat etc. V.+ -- [4.] akḷpta -- [5.] akalpiṣṭa 
future: [1.] klapsyate kalpiṣyate kalpsyati -- [2.] kalpitā kalptā 
verbal: kḷptá V.+ 
secondary: intensive: calkḷp- calīkḷp- -- desiderative: cikḷpsati cikalpiṣate -- causative: kalpáyati kalpáyate etc. V.+ kalpyáte B.+ cikalpayiṣati 
derivatives: kálpa V.+ kalpaka E.+ kalpya E.+ kalpana U.+ kalpanā E.+ kalpanīya U.+ kalpitavya C. kḷ́pti B.+ -kalpayitṛ ŚB. kalpayitavya B.+ 
With this root are apparently related kṛ́p V.B., kṛpa V.+
